name: ida-pro-mcp-fusion
description: IDA Pro MCP with 75+ analysis tools, persistent SQLite cache queries, and multi-binary headless sessions.
long_description: Fusion fork of IDA Pro MCP for agentic reverse engineering. It keeps upstream IDA Pro MCP behavior and adds a persistent SQLite cache, cache query tools, a multi-worker headless idalib supervisor, batch IDB opening, and clean session closing for single-binary and multi-binary reversing workflows. Requires a local IDA Pro installation and IDA's Python/idalib support.

tools.name: idb_open
tools.description: Open a binary or IDB in a persistent headless IDA analysis session.

tools.name: idb_batch_open
tools.description: Open many binaries, warm analysis, and build persistent caches across worker sessions.

tools.name: idb_close
tools.description: Close an owned headless IDA session and terminate its worker cleanly.

tools.name: cache_status
tools.description: Inspect the persistent SQLite cache state for the active IDA database.

tools.name: refresh_cache
tools.description: Refresh cached functions, strings, imports, globals, xrefs, and call graph edges.

tools.name: cache_find_regex
tools.description: Search the persistent cache with regular expressions.

tools.name: decompile_function
tools.description: Return Hex-Rays pseudocode for a function when available.

tools.name: get_xrefs_to
tools.description: Find cross-references to an address or symbol.

tools.name: list_functions
tools.description: List functions discovered in the current database.
